change_summary: Resume short deictic follow-ups from exact Host continuation handles, and keep volatile execution instances out of durable Skills.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill description and decision table make exact continuation handles sufficient subject context for short deictic follow-ups before broad discovery.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-16.2 carries the pre-Skill deictic continuation trigger while production Reply and Writer prompts route volatile instance facts away from durable Skills.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.51 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that exact continuation handles make a short follow-up actionable without replaying prior work.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart trigger the Skill for short deictic follow-ups with exact handles without changing write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the fresh Claude continuation miss and Skill instance-contamination evidence while preserving Agent-owned planning and Runtime execution boundaries.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.51 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover deictic continuation trigger, no-handle counter-boundary, durable Skill instance separation, MCP transport size, package export and localized Help; a fresh semantic rerun is the live behavior gate.
